## Mathematical review performed

- Replaced the nonstandard `assumes_ac` boolean with plan-spec `axiom_use` declarations on all 12 AC-declaring items; removed a wrongly-described MIT citation and added Stacks §10.9 to coverage with a full harvest; corrected the Hatcher locator and a stale page count.
